summary: Primary school teacher with 7 years of experience teaching Year 3 and Year 4 pupils. Careful marker of pupils' work, writer of assessment criteria, and author of termly progress reports.

experience.title: Primary School Teacher
bullets: Marked and graded weekly maths and English work for a class of 28 pupils, identifying recurring errors.
Wrote assessment criteria (rubrics) for end-of-term writing tasks, following National Curriculum standards.
Prepared termly written progress reports for parents and the head teacher.
Helped organise the school's annual Ofsted inspection evidence folders.
Used Microsoft Excel to track pupil assessment scores across the year.

experience.title: Teaching Assistant
bullets: Supported the class teacher with reading groups of 6 pupils.
Checked pupils' homework against answer sheets and reported mistakes to the teacher.
